title: Rabab Kahte Hain Abid
body:
Rubab kehti hai abid isay jaga o nahi
Sakina sooti hai thak Kar abhi utha o nahi.
Rubab kehti ...............(2)
1) Aadu ne baap pa ronay nahi diya isko
Kabhi sukoon say sona nahi diya isko
Abhi toh ankh lagi hai sada laga o nahi.
Rubab kehti ................(2)
2).Bahoot dari hui bachi hai haul khati hai
Agar ho thodi si aahat toh chonk jati hai
Merey aseer pisar baydiyan hilao nahi.
Rubab kehti ................(2)
3).hilaty rehna tum apne aba ke daman ko
Sukoon milta rahey iske zaqmi tan mun ko
Khuli hawaon may rakho aba udao nahi
Rubab kehti .................(2)
4).Sakina haal tumhara agar ya dekhegi
Tadap ke dard say wo apni jaan dedegi
Tum apni ashkon ko istarha say baha o nahi
Rubab kehti ..................(2)
5).A qaidqana yateemi a kamsini a jafa
Chipak kay rehgaya siny say khoon Bhara kurta
Hai taza zakhm abhi pairahan hita o nahi
Rubab kehti ...................(2)
6).A kaisa shoor hai aur kyun laraz rahi hai zameen
Sakina Khwab se bydar ho na jaya kahin
Sitamgaroon say kaho shoor o ghull macha o nahi
Rubab kehti .................. (2)
7).Sada Mujeeb a Ashfaq aur Jarrey ne suni
Baha ke ashkon ko abid se maa ya kehti thi
Ado se kehdo sakina ko ab sata o nahi
Rubab kehti .....................(2)
